name: phase
description: The phases of a game (playing, paused, won, game over, choosing a piece...) and what shows and works in each. One entity holds the current phase; actions move it from phase to phase; every entity that lists the phases it belongs to is shown, and works, only then. The game stays where it is below a pause or a victory screen: no scene change. The phases are the game's own "phase" list.

components.name: Phase
components.description: The current phase: current is an item of the game's "phase" list. One entity has it; if several do, the oldest one counts. The game starts in the first phase unless this says otherwise.

components.name: Transition
components.description: When the action is pressed, the current phase becomes to, if the current phase is one of from (a set of phases) or from_any is on. Any number of entities can carry one: a button of a menu, a Watch's action, a key.

components.name: ShowIn
components.description: The entity is shown only in these phases: in any other it gets transform2d.Hidden, which is taken off again when its phase comes back. The victory screen, a pause menu, a panel.

components.name: ActiveIn
components.description: The entity works only in these phases: in any other it gets transform2d.Disabled, taken off again when its phase comes back. A board that must not move while a victory screen is up. It stays visible: add ShowIn to hide it as well.

systems.name: transition
systems.description: Moves the current phase on the action of the first Transition that is pressed and allowed.

systems.name: apply
systems.description: Hides and switches off the entities that do not belong to the current phase, shows and switches on the others.
